# request-compat

> Drop-in replacement for the deprecated npm package `request` 2.88.2. Same API and behaviour, security holes closed (CVE-2023-28155, cookies and Authorization sent to another host on redirects, a redirect Location that ended the process, certificate pinning skipped behind a proxy, form-data CVE-2025-7783 and CVE-2026-12143), tested on Node 6 to 26, no new features. Install it under the name `request`: `npm install request@npm:request-compat@^2.88.3`, or for a dependency that uses request, `"overrides": { "request": "npm:request-compat@^2.88.3" }` (npm 8.3+).

Use it when code or a dependency still calls `require('request')` and cannot be rewritten. For new code, use Node's `fetch`, undici or got instead.
